raw_text: Looks like JF-17 Block 3 has finally arrived at Kamra. OSINT accounts posting sat imagery of crated airframes. The AESA radar and PL-15 capability is concerning for IAF. This changes the BVR equation on the western front significantly. Anyone know if the EW suite is the domestic or Chinese variant?
clean_text: JF-17 Block 3 arrived at Kamra based on satellite imagery of crated airframes. AESA radar and PL-15 capability changes BVR equation on western front.
